question: I'm an IS sophomore (P-013) on academic warning. I plan to take 67-272 (12 units), 36-200 (9 units), and one more 9-unit course in Spring 2026, totaling 30 units. Am I considered full-time, and does my AW status restrict this?

domain_contributions.policies: Full-time = 36+ units. Part-time requires Dean's exception; going part-time without approval triggers additional academic consequences. AW prohibits overload (not applicable here) but going below 36 units is its own risk.
domain_contributions.courses: Planned load: 67-272 (12 units) + 36-200 (9 units) + one 9-unit course = 30 units — below the 36-unit full-time threshold

key_facts: Full-time status requires 36+ units per semester
Going part-time without Dean of Education exception triggers additional consequences (and can compound AW situation)
P-013 should take at least 36 units to maintain full-time status; a 4th course (e.g., 6-unit mini or another 9-unit course) would bring total to 36
wrong_if_single_domain: Knowing only the AW policy would flag overload risk but miss the part-time risk from being below 36 units. Knowing only the course units shows a 30-unit total but cannot identify the policy implications of being below 36 units.
common_mistake: Focusing only on the AW overload restriction and missing the separate risk of falling below the 36-unit full-time minimum
reasoning_chain: Step 3 (policies): Part-time without Dean approval → additional academic consequences
Conclusion: P-013 needs to add at least 6 more units to maintain full-time status and avoid compounding academic problems
